---
title: "Opportunity on next Australian P15S Cruise"
description: "CSIRO is excited to announce an opportunity for at sea training on the GO-SHIP P15S"
date: "2025-12-05"
---
CSIRO is excited to announce an opportunity for at sea training on the GO-SHIP P15S (170E- Equator to the Ice edge) section for Early Career Ocean Professional from SPC member Pacific Island countries and territories.
Information about this opportunity and application processes can be found at https://oceantrainingpartnership.org/training-call/2026goship/ .
